detail.title: Scrambling Dynamics and Objective Record Accessibility
detail.summary: Scrambling distributes quantum information globally across a system, whereas objective record formation requires redundant broadcasting into the environment. Recent benchmarks and models demonstrate that raw-fragment analyses and noise parameters govern whether local records survive or get suppressed.
detail.reason: Revise the notebook with newly collected peer sources providing raw-fragment benchmarking and refined quantum Darwinism dynamics.
